narration.text: A garden importer's Importer Security Filings made before each cargo is loaded: two due today, one of them on a sailing the carrier moved five days earlier, one due on Sunday, a factory named late and a new warehouse updated before arrival, while the air samples, the bulk pebbles, the Canadian container the carrier files and a rolled sailing are left alone. This is a chore for the import coordinator of a home and garden importer that brings in a few containers a week from Asia and files its own Importer Security Filings. On the bench, she found 5 of 5 eligible items, worth 25,000 dollars of the 25,000 dollars there was to find. She made no false claim. The world held 9 traps, and she walked past 9. She took 3 minutes. By hand, the same chore takes 2 hours, so she was about 35 times faster. The verdict: exceeds. She beat the bar this playbook set itself. The bar was 75 percent of the money, no false claim and inside 60 minutes. Every card she filed waited for a person's signature, and nothing was sent.
